- Segmented on-prem capacity: provision 2 additional dedicated clusters in your East DC (isolated tenant routing, air-gapped config option available)
- Staggered delivery: phased provisioning across two quarters so ops cutover can be validated per site
- Term/discount options: 12 vs 24 month term tradeoffs (discounts at commit + 45-day procurement window)

Attachments: RWD-SOW-AeroMed-2026Q4.pdf, aeromed-vpc-pricing-2026.xlsx

2) procurement timeline (PO by mid-Nov / Dec)?

If you'd like, we can send an amended SOW with the phased schedule and a DocuSign link.

Team —

Noted Elena's asks. Suggested commercial split to send as a follow-up:

- Hardware & cluster provisioning (one-time): $115k per cluster (includes on-site staging, kernel tuning and validation)
- Deployment services (one-time): $28k per site (security hardening, KMS/HSM integration, audit snapshot)
- Platform subscription (recurring): $28k/month for the additional capacity (billing monthly)
- 24-month commit = 12% discount on recurring; 12-month = no discount, but we include one free month of burst credits in month 1

Operational fallback: if provisioning misses the renewal date we can extend routing to current clusters with prefix KV caching and a temporary capacity burst on Dedicated for up to 45 days (costed separately).

Action items:
- Monica: can you confirm staging windows for East DC and any blackout windows?
- Laura: please prep a 24-month term SOW and a 12-month alternative with the 3-month metric gate language.

- Live cutover (customer-facing): 48-72 hour maintenance window per cluster, scheduled on weekends
- Compliance tasks: KMS keys must be provisioned by AeroMed and shared with our onboarding team via the secure key exchange (we provide instructions in the SOW). SOC2 extract and attestation we can provide as an addendum; Laura, please attach the latest SOC2 snapshot.

Suggested schedule:
1) Cluster A (East DC) provision start: week of Nov 29 — validation complete by Dec 13
2) Cluster B (East DC) provision start: week of Jan 10 — validation complete by Jan 24

This timeline assumes PO by Nov 15 and signed SOW. If procurement slips, we can shift start dates into January but risk missing Q1 performance gates.

I'll join the technical kickoff call and own migration runbooks.
